# Mount Elizabeth Hospitals

> Leading private healthcare provider in Singapore offering 40+ years of experience with comprehensive medical specialties, advanced facilities, and patient-centered care across multiple locations.

Mount Elizabeth Hospitals operates multiple locations in Singapore (Novena, Orchard, Royal Square) and provides specialized care in oncology, cardiology, fertility, and advanced treatments like proton therapy. The hospital network serves both local and international patients with 850+ doctors and allied health professionals.

## Getting Started

- [Mount Elizabeth Hospitals: It's Possible](https://www.mountelizabeth.com.sg): Mount Elizabeth Hospitals Singapore homepage with 40+ years of private healthcare experience.
- [Find a Doctor](https://www.mountelizabeth.com.sg/find-doctor): Search 850+ doctors and allied health professionals at Mount Elizabeth.
- [Information for Patients & Visitors](https://www.mountelizabeth.com.sg/patient-visitors): Patient and visitor information hub for hospital services, appointments, and billing.

## Patient Services & Support

- [Hospital Admissions Guide](https://www.mountelizabeth.com.sg/hospital-admissions): Guide to hospital admission procedures, stay, and discharge processes.
- [International Patients Guide](https://www.mountelizabeth.com.sg/international-patients-guide): Guide for international patients seeking medical treatment in Singapore.
- [Billing & Payment - Estimate Hospital Charges & Using Your Insurance](https://www.mountelizabeth.com.sg/billing-payment): Payment options, bill estimation, and insurance information for patients.
- [Hospital Bill Estimator](https://www.mountelizabeth.com.sg/hospital-bill-estimator): Tool to estimate hospital bills and medical insurance claims for procedures.
- [Visiting Hours & Hospital Locations](https://www.mountelizabeth.com.sg/visitor-information): Visiting hours (8am-8pm), locations, and directions for Mount Elizabeth.

## Hospital Facilities & Accommodations

- [Hospital Facilities](https://www.mountelizabeth.com.sg/hospital-facilities): Hospital facilities including endoscopy, day surgery, theatres, and ICU.
- [Hospital Wards & Rooms](https://www.mountelizabeth.com.sg/hospital-wards-rooms): Hospital room and ward options from suites to single and multi-bed rooms.

## Medical Specialties & Services

- [Specialties](https://www.mountelizabeth.com.sg/specialties): Medical specialties including cancer care, cardiology, fertility, and proton therapy.
- [Cancer Care](https://www.mountelizabeth.com.sg/conditions-treatments/cancer-care): Comprehensive cancer care, screenings, treatments, and recovery support.
- [Heart Health (Cardiology)](https://www.mountelizabeth.com.sg/conditions-treatments/heart-health): Cardiology services with expert diagnostics and minimally invasive treatments.
- [Bone & Orthopaedic Health](https://www.mountelizabeth.com.sg/conditions-treatments/bone-health): Bone and orthopaedic health services for structural and movement support.
- [Maternity - What to Expect & Our Maternity Care](https://www.mountelizabeth.com.sg/explore-maternity): Maternity and child delivery services overview for expecting mothers.
